title: Live Job Tracking for Glaziers | On-Our-Way Texts & Tracking Page | Coglass
description: When your fitter taps On my way, Coglass texts the customer a tracking link: an arrival window, where they are in the day's stops, and a chat with the office or the fitter.
lead: Your fitter taps On my way in the phone app and the customer gets a text with a link to their tracking page: when to expect the team, which stop they are today, and a way to message the office or the fitter directly.
steps_h2: From the van to the customer's phone
steps_sub: Nothing for the office to do — it runs off the day's bookings on the planner.
steps: Visits are booked on the planner. Customers can get a booking confirmation when you book them in.
The fitter taps On my way
In the phone app, or the office presses it on the planner.
A text with the tracking link goes out automatically — once per booking — under your company name.
The page shows the arrival window and which stop they are today, and they can message the office or the fitter.
inc_sub: A simple page in your branding — no app for the customer to download.
included: Sent when the fitter taps On my way. You can change the wording, or send it by email instead, in Automations.
An expected time window worked out from the day's bookings, never earlier than the booked time.
Customers see where they are in today's visits.
Questions about the booking go to the office, on the job.
Door codes and parking notes go straight to the person coming.
One tap to ring your office.
Your company name, contact details and colour.
Each link is personal to the customer and stops working a while after the visit.
cta_h2: Let customers know you're coming — automatically
cta_p: Book a demo and we will walk you through a day on the planner — or pick a plan and start a 14-day trial.
